news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions Q4 Earnings Call Highlights
news.summary: Fiscal Q4 revenue rose 94% to $462M with record bookings of $1.5B and a $3.0B backlog. FY2027 guidance is $2.4-2.6B revenue and $575-625M adj. EBITDA.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions Starts Fiscal 2027 with $3 Billion Backlog and Strong Growth Outlook
news.summary: Backlog covers over 90% of the FY2027 revenue outlook, and a Tijuana expansion should lift revenue capacity to about $5.8B.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q1 2027 results
catalysts.detail: Management said Q1 revenue and adj. EBITDA will exceed the high end of prior guidance.

catalysts.label: Tijuana Powertrain expansion online
catalysts.detail: Expected to raise total revenue capacity to about $5.8B.

pulse: Forgent is scaling quickly on data-center and grid demand, with a $3.0B backlog and FY2027 guidance about 20% above consensus. Fiscal Q1 results on Nov 12 are the next checkpoint.
